data.title: S&P meets Romania’s finance minister Alexandru Nazare in Bucharest
data.description: The minister said the fiscal consolidation already achieved is a strong argument for maintaining Romania’s investment-grade rating, but acknowledged that political instability remains a concern for the rating agency. As a minister in a caretaker government, with limited powers to initiate new legislation and no clear political mandate for the 2027 budget, Nazare’s position is relatively weak in front of the rating agency experts, who will seek to assess to what extent the political instability is putting the country’s fiscal consolidation at risk. Their task is complicated by the fact that prime minister-designate Siegfried Mureșan (PNL) is seeking parliamentary support for a minority government, while the Social Democrats have decided not to support his proposed cabinet. Mureșan has nevertheless continued negotiations with parliamentary groups, meaning that the policy direction of the next government remains uncertain. This leaves the rating agency with limited visibility on the fiscal policy that will follow the current consolidation effort. PSD has historically advocated a more expansionary social and fiscal agenda than the policies pursued by the Ilie Bolojan government, particularly around wages, pensions and taxation, while rating agencies have repeatedly stressed the need for sustained fiscal consolidation and policy continuity. The question for S&P is therefore not only whether the current government can deliver on this year’s deficit target, but whether the next government will maintain the adjustment path. “Our main argument remains the budget execution,” finance minister Nazare said in a Facebook post after meeting S&P experts. “The figures demonstrate that the adjustment regards not only the deficit, but begins being visible in the structure of the budget. We have demonstrated that we can reduce the deficit and keep spending under control, while protecting investments financed from European funds and directing more resources towards projects with high economic impact. The results of the last months continue to confirm the adjustment started last year and support the arguments that I presented today regarding the achievement of the targets assumed for this year,” he added. The talks also focused on the difficulties of the current period, including political uncertainties, external pressures and those on financing costs, while also presenting the Ministry of Finance's strategy for the next stage, the minister also stated. According to him, the main focus remains on spending discipline, prioritizing investments and capitalizing on European funds.

data.title: Civic campaign proposes Bucharest low-emission zone from 2028
data.description: A civic campaign is calling for Bucharest to introduce Romania’s first low-emission zone from 2028, following models already used in cities such as Paris, Brussels, Madrid, Warsaw, and Berlin. The #RespirăBucurești initiative aims to collect 100,000 signatures before asking the Bucharest General Council and City Hall to draw up the necessary regulations. Under the proposed model, access for higher-polluting vehicles would be restricted or subject to conditions gradually, based on their emission standards. Campaign organizers said the transition should be accompanied by investment in public transport, dedicated lanes, cycling infrastructure, and park-and-ride facilities at the city’s entrances. “Bucharest residents no longer need simply to be told that the air is polluted. We need to discuss solutions and begin implementing them,” said Mihai Stoica, a representative of the Bucharest Association for Sustainable Mobility. The campaign cited measurements conducted by the 2Celsius and Ecopolis associations at 21 Bucharest locations in 2024. Average nitrogen dioxide concentrations exceeded the annual legal limit of 40 micrograms per cubic meter at six sites, while all 21 recorded levels above the World Health Organization’s recommended threshold of 10 micrograms per cubic meter. The highest average concentration, 53.5 micrograms per cubic meter, was measured on Calea Victoriei near the National Military Circle. Bucharest’s 2018-2022 Integrated Air Quality Plan attributed approximately 60% of the city’s air pollution to road traffic. “A low-emission zone should not be, and is not, a measure against drivers,” campaign representative Anamaria Gram said. “It must form part of a broader plan that gives people alternatives to using their personal cars.” More than 300 European cities already operate low-emission zones, according to the campaign. Bucharest residents can download the signature form and find details about volunteer collection points on the Respiră București (Breathe Bucharest) website .

data.title: Romanian prosecutors seize Călin Georgescu’s villa in EUR 1.1 mln fraud case
data.description: Romania’s organized crime (DIICOT) prosecutors have placed a precautionary seizure on a villa belonging to former presidential candidate Călin Georgescu in Mogoșoaia, Ilfov county. The measure was ordered in a fraud case involving estimated losses of more than EUR 1.1 million. The Directorate for Investigating Organized Crime and Terrorism announced that it imposed the measure on September 24 against a property owned by a 64-year-old defendant investigated for allegedly forming an organized crime group and committing continued fraud with particularly serious consequences. According to News.ro , the defendant is Cǎlin Georgescu, who was initially detained for 24 hours and subsequently placed under judicial supervision in this case. He can challenge the prosecutors’ seizure order. The property could be used to recover the alleged EUR 1.1 million loss if Georgescu is convicted by a final court ruling, Digi24 noted. The prosecutors allege that members of the group began misleading the victim at meetings in Romania in September 2021 and later continued the operation in the United Kingdom. The suspects allegedly claimed that they could secure a EUR 6 million bank loan for the victim if a guarantee was deposited. The victim subsequently transferred more than EUR 1 million, prosecutors said. The group then allegedly promised to increase the loan to EUR 15 million in exchange for an additional guarantee, prompting the victim to transfer another EUR 100,000. DIICOT said the total loss exceeded EUR 1.1 million. The investigation is the third criminal case involving Cǎlin Georgescu. In the other two, he faces charges related to alleged attempts to undermine the constitutional order and the promotion of fascist or legionary propaganda. Cǎlin Georgescu was the surprise first-place finisher in the first round of Romania’s 2024 presidential election, which was annulled by the Constitutional Court .

data.title: Romanian-American University launches "High School Innovation Challenge", the first national AI and Business competition for high school students
data.description: The Romanian-American University, together with Google Romania and TotalSoft, Strategic Partners , is launching "High School Innovation Challenge" (HSIC), the first national AI and Business competition dedicated to innovative high school students. The initiative aims to support entrepreneurial spirit, critical thinking and the development of digital skills among young people, giving them the opportunity to turn ideas into projects with real-world applicability and impact. The relevance of the project is also strengthened by the involvement of the local public administration in Bucharest. At its meeting on September 9, 2026, the Sector 1 Local Council approved a cooperation protocol with the Romanian-American University to support the "High School Innovation Challenge" educational program, 2026 edition . Through this protocol, high school students have free access to practical activities focused on artificial intelligence, entrepreneurship and innovation. The program also places emphasis on critical thinking, creativity, collaboration, communication, and the ethical and responsible use of artificial intelligence. "For the Romanian-American University, High School Innovation Challenge is a concrete way to build, from high school onwards, bridges between education, technology and the world in which young people will work and create. At a time when artificial intelligence is rapidly changing the way we learn and work, we believe it is essential for students not only to learn how to use technology, but also to understand it, put it at the service of ideas, and take responsibility for how they use it. The fact that this project is supported through a cooperation protocol approved by the Sector 1 Local Council and provides free access for students further strengthens its dimension as an educational initiative with public impact." said Prof. univ. dr. habil. Costel Negricea, Rector of the Romanian-American University. For Google Romania, involvement in the project supports the need to develop skills that go beyond the occasional use of artificial intelligence tools. "The generations entering high school today will be the first to build and work in an economy where artificial intelligence will be a natural part of almost every field. That is why we believe AI education must go beyond tools and help young people ask the right questions: what problem do we want to solve, who are we building a solution for, what value can it bring, and what responsibilities do we take on when using this technology? High School Innovation Challenge creates exactly this space for experimentation and learning, where students can turn curiosity into ideas, and ideas into solutions with real potential." said Elisabeta Moraru, Country Manager, Google Romania. High School Innovation Challenge is aimed at students in grades 9 to 12, regardless of their field of study, who can register in teams of 2 to 5 members. No advanced programming experience is required. Participants will identify real problems in their communities or society and develop technology-based solutions, following a process from idea to prototype and, subsequently, toward a solution with implementation potential. Throughout the eight-week competition, participants will receive guidance from faculty members of the Romanian-American University and mentors involved in the project. The process is structured into two main stages: "From Idea to Prototype" , taking place from October 5 to November 1, and "From Prototype to Startup" , from November 2 to 29. Students will work on market analysis, customer discovery, development of the first MVP, automation and AI agents, business strategy, costs and KPIs, while also benefiting from pitch sessions and feedback from mentors. "Artificial intelligence will change not only the technology we use, but also the way companies, products and professions will be built in the coming years. For a technology company such as TotalSoft, innovation also means the responsibility to pass on the experience we have accumulated and to create contexts in which the new generation can experiment, build and learn directly from people who develop technology every day. Through High School Innovation Challenge, we want to offer young people more than access to AI: the confidence that they themselves can become creators of the next generation of technology-based solutions and businesses." said Gorkem Tursucu, CEO of TotalSoft. Through its involvement in High School Innovation Challenge, TotalSoft brings to the program the perspective of applied innovation in the business environment and its experience in developing software solutions used internationally. The company's specialists will help students explore the possibilities offered by AI, automation and new software development models, and understand how technology can evolve from an experiment into a product with relevance for the economy and society. In the final stage, selected teams will benefit from individual mentoring, product and business feedback, and 1:1 Pitch Coaching sessions. The grand final will take place on December 5, 2026 , in the Aula Magna of the Romanian-American University, where finalists will present their projects to a jury made up of professors, entrepreneurs and experts. In addition to the practical experience and mentoring provided by specialists, participants will receive certificates of participation, while the winning projects will receive technology prizes and the opportunity to join an international startup accelerator. Finalists will also have priority in educational programs and camps organized by the Romanian-American University for high school students. The total value of the prizes provided by the organizers and program partners exceeds 65,000 euro , of which 45,000 euro are awarded as study scholarships , while more than 20,000 euro are offered in products and cash prizes. Registration for High School Innovation Challenge is open until October 2, 2026, inclusive , and the competition will take place from October 5 to December 5, 2026 . More information about the competition and registration is available at liceeni.rau.ro .

data.title: Electronic gradebook to become mandatory in Romania starting with 2027-2028
data.description: However, the public platform, which will support all information about students’ academic situation, is already delayed. The Ministry of Education is only now beginning to work on it, with a completion deadline more than three years away. Nevertheless, many schools already have an electronic gradebook. At the Bănățean National College in Timișoara, the electronic gradebook has already been used for several years. Teachers enter grades and absences directly into the application, which can be installed on any phone or tablet. The change has brought major benefits for teachers, parents and students. Parents can instantly see their academic situation, and they receive notifications if absences appear. Students enjoy the up-to-date information as well. “On the one hand, communication with parents is much more direct, much faster, much more efficient. On the other hand, we reduce the degree of bureaucracy. Absences are easier to monitor,” said Sorin Ionescu, principal of the Bănățean National College in Timișoara, cited by Digi24 . The electronic gradebook will become mandatory starting from the next school year, according to a 2004 ministerial order. The Ministry of Education has announced that it is preparing a national and free electronic gradebook platform for all schools in the country, which is scheduled to become operational by the end of 2029.

data.title: Romania’s car market drops 10.6% in first eight months of 2026
data.description: Of the new passenger cars registered, around 7,000 were fully electric (+50%), and 49,282 units had hybrid propulsion (+2.1%). The association said that in August 2026, new passenger car registrations in the European Union increased by 4.5% compared with August 2025, reaching 708,211 units. As such, between January and August 2026, 7.546.397 passenger cars were registered in the EU, up 5.3% compared with the same period in 2025. Of the total number of passenger cars registered in the EU, 1,641,333 units were fully electric, representing an increase of 44.5%, accounting for 21.7% of the total market, while 3,517,800 units had hybrid propulsion (17.6%), compared with the January-August 2025 period. The association said that compared with the first eight months of 2025, increases in new passenger car registrations were recorded in France (3%), Germany (4.8%), Spain (6.3%) and Italy (8.5%), while Romania saw a decline of 10.6%. “As regards automobile manufacturers, the largest number of new passenger cars registered across Europe in the first eight months was represented by the VW Group, with 2,359,023 units, up 0.9%, followed by the Stellantis Group with 1,360,488 units, up 4.7%, and the Renault Group with 857,937 units, down 3.3% (of which DACIA: 360,657 units, down 9.7% compared with January-August 2025),” ACAROM said. At the same time, Ford passenger cars accounted for 244,938 newly registered units between January and August 2026, down 14.4% compared with the first eight months of 2025.

data.title: Romania’s interim government launches transparency platform for state-owned companies
data.description: The guvernanta.gov.ro platform, created at the initiative of deputy prime Minister Oana Gheorghiu, centralizes information on the management of state-owned companies. For the first time, the platform includes information on 121 active companies under the subordination, coordination, or authority of a central tutelary public institution, as well as on the people holding management positions within them. Specifically, the platform provides access to more than 1,350 public documents concerning members of boards of directors or supervisory boards and executive boards. Of these, more than 650 are CVs of people holding management positions, while more than 600 are management contracts. According to the aggregated information, more than 100 people hold at least two positions simultaneously. More than 370 people receive monthly incomes of up to RON 25,000, 115 receive incomes between RON 25,000 and 50,000, 36 receive incomes between RON 50,000 and 100,000, while one person receives more than RON 100,000 (EUR 20,000) per month, according to Economedia . The platform is part of the broader effort to reform state-owned companies and increase transparency regarding the qualifications, salaries, and benefits of appointees, an effort necessary for good governance and to strategically support Romania’s position internationally in economic terms. “Increasing transparency and opening the doors to what is happening inside state-owned companies is the way we will be able to properly ask the question: are they useful or not? To make a correct diagnosis of a company, you have to see its results, and these results depend to a large extent on the people who make the key decisions in these companies,” deputy prime minister Oana Gheorghiu said. https://www.facebook.com/oana.gheorghiu.58/posts/pfbid033uuzngBSwZwgw1E3QKhmTrDRc4CaGnvqjaggBrXgPrPnLYiP7ALxLgpL3ScFNzQrl

data.title: Les Films de Cannes à Bucarest: Festival announces highlights of 2026 edition
data.description: Between October 23 and November 1, Elvire Popesco Cinema, Romanian Peasant Museum Cinema, the Auditorium Hall of the National Museum of Art of Romania, and Apollo 111 will host the festival’s 17th edition in Bucharest. In Timișoara, audiences are invited to Studio Cinema and Timiș Cinema from October 22 to October 25. The festival continues in Arad, with screenings at Arta Cinema from October 28 to October 31. In Oradea, the films will be screened at Cinema Palace from October 29 to November 1; additionally, on October 29, the Crișana Museum (Muzeul Țării Crișurilor) will host a special screening of Cristian Mungiu’s 4 Months, 3 Weeks and 2 Days. The festival tour concludes in Iași, where the public is invited to Ateneu Cinema from November 6 to November 8. Sebastian Stan in Cristian Mungiu's Fjord Photo: Voodoo Films Cristian Mungiu’s Fjord , this year’s Palme d’Or winner, will be screened on October 24, in a simultaneous showing across all participating cinemas in Bucharest and the rest of the country. That same evening in Bucharest, the film will also have a gala screening at the Romanian Athenaeum. The festival’s program will also include Andrey Zvyagintsev’s Minotaur , the winner of the Grand Prix at Cannes and France’s submission for the Oscars. The film follows the downfall of a wealthy Russian CEO whose life is destabilized by professional pressures, the war in Ukraine, and suspicions of his wife’s infidelity. German filmmaker Valeska Grisebach’s The Dreamed Adventure , winner of this year’s Jury Prize in Cannes, will have the local premiere at Les Films de Cannes à Bucarest. The film follows Veska as she attempts to help an old friend recover a car stolen in the mountains of Bulgaria. Also making its Romanian premiere at Les Films de Cannes à Bucarest will be Emmanuel Marre’s A Man of His Time , winner of the Best Screenplay award at Cannes. Henri Marre is a writer who arrives in Vichy in 1940 with a political manuscript, seeking a position within Pétain’s new regime. His desire for influence draws him into the game of collaboration, where personal ambition clashes with moral compromise. Still from La Bola Negra Photo: Voodoo Films La Bola Negra , directed by Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi, won the award for Best Director in Cannes, sharing the honor with Fatherland , directed by Paweł Pawlikowski. Both films are part of the festival’s program. A queer period drama, La Bola Negra intertwines the stories of three men from different generations against the backdrop of key moments in Spanish history, from the Civil War and the Franco dictatorship to the present day. Paweł Pawlikowski’s Fatherland , set during the Cold War, focuses on the relationship between the writer Thomas Mann (Hanns Zischler) and his daughter Erika (Sandra Hüller), an actress, writer, and rally driver, as they embark on a journey across a Germany in ruins. Another film premiering at the festival is Soudain , directed by Ryūsuke Hamaguchi and starring Virginie Efira and Tao Okamoto, joint winners of the Best Actress award at Cannes. Lukas Dhont’s Coward , for which actors Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne received the Best Actor award, will also screen at the festival, as will Marine Atlan’s feature-film debut La Gradiva , co-written with Anne Brouillet. The film, winner of the Grand Prize at Semaine de la Critique, follows a group of French high school students who travel to Pompeii, where the ruins and the weight of history trigger emotional turmoil, desires, and conflicts. The full program of the festival will be announced in the coming period. Tickets will go on sale through the Eventbook network in early October. Tickets for the Romanian premiere of Fjord will go on sale on October 1.

data.title: Romanian prosecutors arrest 10 over violence at shepherd’s protest, 14 more proposed for detention
data.description: Judicial control was imposed on 3 other defendants for 60 days, with specific obligations, including a ban on participating in public gatherings. Another 14 people charged in the same case will appear before a judge with a proposal for pre-trial detention. Overall, 27 people were detained during searches for the violent protest this week. They have the status of defendants and were accused of assaulting a public official, assault or other violence, destruction, and disturbing public order and peace. According to the investigation, the individuals assaulted both gendarmes and journalists during the protest . “Hard objects were thrown at gendarmes while they were carrying out their duties, with several of them being hit. Physical violence was also committed against two employees of a media company, and a vehicle belonging to the Romanian Gendarmerie was damaged,” the Prosecutor’s Office said in its press release . Among those investigated for violent acts and placed in pre-trial detention were two members of the far-right Alliance for the Union of Romanians (AUR). The two are suspected of having taken part in clashes with the gendarmes and in the attempt to overturn a Gendarmerie vehicle. In connection with their arrest, AUR first deputy chairman Petrișor Peiu said that the party had no involvement in organizing the demonstration and that it will not defend its members if it is proven that they broke the law, according to Ziare.com .

Physical violence was also committed against two employees of a media company, and a vehicle belonging to the Romanian Gendarmerie was damaged,” the Prosecutor’s Office said in its press release . Among those investigated for violent acts and placed in pre-trial detention were two members of the far-right Alliance for the Union of Romanians (AUR). The two are suspected of having taken part in clashes with the gendarmes and in the attempt to overturn a Gendarmerie vehicle. In connection with their arrest, AUR first deputy chairman Petrișor Peiu said that the party had no involvement in organizing the demonstration and that it will not defend its members if it is proven that they broke the law, according to Ziare.com .

data.title: Premier Energy Group, first tenant of PPF Real Estate’s office project in Bucharest’s Basarab area
data.description: Premier Energy Group, an energy infrastructure company operating in Southeastern Europe, has signed a lease agreement at ARC, PPF Real Estate’s flagship office development currently under construction in Bucharest’s Basarab area, the developer announced. Premier Energy Group will occupy approximately 3,000 square meters, equivalent to one full floor of the building. The relocation is expected to take place in the first quarter of 2027 following completion of the project. Located two kilometers from Victoriei Square, ARC is positioned within an area that is home to numerous multinational companies and is served by direct access to metro, rail, tram and bus networks. Scheduled for completion in the first quarter of 2027, the building will provide approximately 30,000 square meters of leasable space. PPF Real Estate Holding develops and manages projects in the Czech Republic, the Netherlands, Germany, the UK, Poland, Romania and the USA. Its real estate footprint covers the management and development of commercial, hospitality and residential properties. Premier Energy Group is a vertically integrated energy infrastructure company operating in Southeastern Europe, with activities spanning renewable electricity production, electricity and natural gas distribution, and electricity and natural gas supply. It operates across Romania, Hungary, the Republic of Moldova and other markets in the region, serving a large residential, commercial and industrial customer base. Premier Energy PLC is listed on the Bucharest Stock Exchange under the symbol "PE" and is majority-owned by EMMA Capital, the investment group founded by Czech entrepreneur Jiří Šmejc.

data.title: Two Romanian anti-drone systems modernized by Rheinmetall fail acceptance tests
data.description: In December 2023, Romtehnica Company awarded a EUR 328 million framework contract, negotiated without prior publication, to German company Rheinmetall Landsysteme GmbH. The program, carried out by the General Staff of the Land Forces, provided for the modernization of 4 systems (24 guns) of Oerlikon GDF 103 anti-aircraft artillery, with the introduction of C-RAM capabilities. C-RAM stands for Counter-Rocket, Artillery and Mortar, meaning countering rockets, artillery projectiles, and mortars. This capability essentially means transforming anti-aircraft guns into a system capable of detecting, tracking, and intercepting small projectiles and rockets approaching protected targets. “The modernization of the systems includes, but is not limited to, the provision of modern detection radars and battery-level command posts, as well as the integration of high-tech tracking radars and electro-optical systems,” the MAPN documents reviewed by G4Media state. During the testing and evaluation activities carried out for the acceptance of the first two Oerlikon GDF 103 systems, “it was found that some subsystems did not fully meet the requirements of the technical procurement specification.” This was due to “technical malfunctions, as well as difficulties encountered by it in the supply chain for the equipment necessary to fulfill the contracts,” the institution said. The systems sent for modernization could, with the necessary adaptations, be highly effective in shooting down drones. They were due to be delivered in April 2026, but will now have to be replaced with penalties for delays. Romania currently has the MEROPS system for fighting drones, supplied by the United States of America as part of the bilateral strategic partnership. The system is operational and integrated into the Romanian Army’s defense system and is specifically intended to detect, track, and neutralize small-sized aerial targets at low altitudes. The Romanian Army also has Gepard self-propelled anti-aircraft systems, used in the defense system, and an integrated system of sensors and radars. So far, Romania has shot down 4 Russian drones that entered national airspace illegally with F-16 jets. The Romanian Army has several systems in its procurement plan to create a layered and integrated C-UAS (Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems) architecture. Most will be purchased with SAFE funds. The new delivery deadline for the first two would be September, the Defense Ministry said. President Nicușor Dan commented on the delay in delivery, noting that “these things happen,” and that the acceptance procedure can be corrected. “Regarding what you are asking me about Rheinmetall, these things happen. It is an acceptance procedure that can be corrected. As far as I understand, it is not under the SAFE program, but an earlier procurement by the Romanian state; these things happen,” Nicușor Dan said in an interview with Antena 3 CNN .

data.title: Romania’s largest online retailer eMAG announces date for Black Friday 2026
data.description: This year, Black Friday will be on November 6, according to information obtained by Profit.ro from the company. Other retailers are also expected to hold Black Friday on the same day, even though many platforms launch promotions earlier, with Black Friday campaigns spread over several days or even weeks. Last year, Romanians bought all kinds of things during Black Friday, from a RON 27,000 bottle of collectible champagne and TVs worth almost RON 110,000, to shower gels sold in more than 17,000 units. The highest value order from a single individual stood at RON 214,490 (EUR 40,600). Top 3 categories with the highest percentage and value increases compared with the previous year were food supplements & pharmaceutical products; cosmetics & beauty; and groceries & gourmet products. The average order value increased by 17% compared with 2024, even though online advertising costs rose by more than 11%. In terms of volume, the most sought-after products were those in the Coffee & Whiskey category, confirming the increasingly refined preferences of Romanian shoppers. Last year, studies on Romanians' purchasing habits showed that they traded impulsive buys for strategic purchases.

data.title: Romanian Film Review: Y, The Story of Pogány Induló, 3 Days in September
data.description: Autumn is finally here, which means the many new releases are lining up in cinemas and streamers are keeping up. Maria Popistașu and Alexandru Baciu’s Y is now available on HBO Max after its theatrical run in summer. Certainly the most beautiful film of the year, it’s also one of its most intriguing. In a Bucharest bubble of privilege, a family unravels after the matriarch passes away and her potentially horrifying acquisition of said wealth is questioned. Well, sort of, because it’s just one member of the family that struggles: the oldest granddaughter, stoic and unreadable Olga. In the 1990s, her grandmother worked with orphans and facilitated adoptions, but the unchecked process had much darker sides: was it an act of saving them or trafficking them for organs? The failure of state and authorities is such a sombre topic that the film suddenly inserts disturbing archive material of abused children in orphanages. A jarring choice, as if the elegant form and bourgeois setting cannot express it otherwise. And so, Olga’s stylishly curated life threatens to be destabilised. There is so much to like about the film, from its perfectly choreographed group scenes, moments of humour and vulnerability laced with excellently delivered sarcasm, jabs at unchecked privilege, elegant, unhurried flow, the matter-of-fact treatment of homosexuality (Olga has a female partner, a fact that seemingly does not faze anyone). And above all the aforementioned beauty, a protagonist in its own right: with its perfect and perfectly coloured frames, exquisite interiors and best dressed protagonists. But this is also where is gets frustrating: the conflict is so serious and the film remains strangely shy of giving it more depth, preferring to avoid the horrors of ethical questions and staying within the safe, comforting realm of beauty. The avoidance is very much in step with Olga’s journey, and the mere suggestion of moral corruption is enough to make the perfect picture crack, but I am torn between understanding the approach and finding it a bit too comfortable. Still, a very much recommended watch from my side. https://youtu.be/3HHxS69DgEM?si=O_2xgx_8Cg9OtpzO HBO Max has also been showing Meant to Be – The Story of Pogány Induló , which is also an HBO production and I am thrilled to see a new documentary from the region. Director Olivér Márk Tóth follows Marcell Szirmai as he rises to fast and huge success as a rapper with the eponymous stage name when he is barely 17. The following few years unfold as a very personal journey of mega stardom, struggles with alcohol and pushing one’s limits, but also with great tenderness and humour (the grandmother is a scene-stealer). Marci is self-destructive, impulsive, at the same time assured, eloquent, emotionally aware and sometimes more mature than some ‘grown-ups’. No surprise he is a star; he also carries the film. https://youtu.be/Kj8dZxH3ozg?si=d7k_N3KwVdEes-23 In theatres, Tudor Giurgiu’s new film 3 zile în septembrie/ 3 Days in September is one his most entertaining ones. It plays out (almost) in real time after a wedding reception combusts when a woman storms in, throws eight positive pregnancy tests at the bride and exposes the husband as a cheating douchebag. While everyone is trying to save the party, the bride runs away and spends the night drifting through the seaside resort, stumbling into another wedding and a ceremony of womanhood, meets a trio of actors in animal costumes, and is comforted by a lonely lady. Her odyssey is one interrupted shot, which is a bit of a gimmick, but it conveys the aimless energy of a chaotic night. Andreea Vasile as Bianca screams, cries, laughs, runs, dances her way through the film fantastically. What a power show! I just wish her character was given a more rebellious arc: the guys she meets are not much better than her groom, and the women tell her to calm down and get back to her man. I hoped she would ignore them all and decide to be done with men altogether and social expectations, a very possible reaction in this scenario. I wonder if three men having written the screenplay have something to do with it, especially with an ending that spins a conventional reading. But for a fun, propulsive one-night wild ride, I was happy to tag along. https://youtu.be/yL5rQW0oH8c?si=M3kJ2tomhxE1cMWe

data.title: Where the Harvest Has Nowhere to Go
data.description: Russian attacks have crippled Ukraine's Black Sea export routes, crashing local grain prices even as global wheat futures rise. In Kherson's Posad-Pokrovske, farmers Vyacheslav Dolholutskyi and Fedor Shpak work fields under drone threat, supplementing income through irrigation-canal jobs to survive a harvest they can barely sell. Both rebuilt after fleeing occupation in 2022. Now, with wheat prices halved and no compensation, they face a deeper question: whether small farming – and the villages it sustains – can continue at all.

data.title: NATO Scrambles F-16s and F-18s in Failed Intercept of Russian War Drone Over Romania

data.title: DSP o Maquiavélico Ganancioso
data.description: Guineenses, mais uma vez, venho para vos alertar sobre o perigo que Domingos Simões Pereira representa para a Guiné-Bissau. Faço esse alerta a todos os guineenses sem exceção que se encontre no país ou no estrangeiro, ao PAIGC em especial e na pessoa do Cipriano Cassamá em concreto. Alerta esse sobre o verdadeiro DSP, o verdadeiro espírito que move esse sujeito, o qual alguns ainda continuam a acreditar para não dizer adorar. Domingos Simões Pereira é um manipulador, um verdadeiro chantagista e calculista provavelmente, tipo de comportamento que ultrapassa o nível de psicopata. U m ambicioso desmedido, um verdadeiro criminoso que sabe como e quando cometer o crime. Ele jamais coabitaria não só com JOMAV, assim como com qualquer presidente que seria eleito, a não ser o que ele apoiou disfarçadamente. Isto porque ele tem sua própria agenda, e o PAIGC é simplesmente uma plataforma para sua concretização. DSP jamais coabitaria com JOMAV porque o seu candidato preferido era o Paulo Gomes e sempre será, o qual juntamente com Tchitchi vão delineando mecanismo de modo a serem os novos donos da Guiné-Bissau. Segundo eles este é um processo a médio prazo, e é preciso coragem e paciência para concretiza-lo. Ganhar o congresso não importa em que circunstância e ter novamente o partido na mão, é uma fase concluída em proveito deles, enquanto verdadeiros militantes do PAIGC estão a bater palmas. Depois dessa eleição legislativa, não importa o resultado, o Cipriano Cassama que se prepare a mala ou fica de bico fechado, pois o candidato preferido para o partido será o Paulo Gomes, e esse sim deve ter a voz dentro do partido. DSP é um ambicioso desmedido, nunca teve consideração por ninguém, JOMAV muito menos, o sujeito é um maquiavélico nato, Cipriano Casama será descartado quando menos esperar podes tomar a nota. Guineenses, falar do Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi é falar do MCCI e demais outras organizações e personalidades camufladas no nosso país. Esses dois indivíduos são os principais financiadores do MCCI e demais outras personalidades boca de aluguel na cidade de Bissau. O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

O MCCI, Milícia idealizado por JBV e DSP, agora financiado e dirigido por "futuro triângulo do poder" ou seja, "DSP, Paulo Gomes e Tchitchi", têm 3 principais objectivos: 1º Perturbar a ordem pública em nome da cidadania, difamar e tentar descredibilizar qualquer que seja organizações ou indivíduos não alinhados ao triângulo, de modo a suportar suas caminhadas na busca do poder. 2º Caso se concretize o objectivo do triângulo, o papel da Milícia do MCCI passará a ser de vigilância constante a todos os adversários de modo a garantir falsa paz social e o poder de controlo. 3º Tentar ganhar credibilidade junto das organizações internacionais e regionais, através de suas visitas e actividades de fachada, para quando houver as tais actividades de perturbações de ordem pública, poderem ganhar notoriedade. Mas isso não deve preocupar ninguém, pois estão bem identificados e bem caçados, dentro e fora da Guiné-Bissau. Não tenho nada contra ninguém, mas quem continuar a perturbar verdadeira paz social dos guineenses em troca de benefícios como sempre foi nos últimos anos dessa crise, e que sempre tenho tolerado, então que fique claro "estou firme e determinado para tudo e todos". Para finalizar, gostaria de vos deixar uma reflexão com a seguinte frase: " Domingos Simões Pereira é um perigo grave para o futuro do país ". Isto porque publicar aqui tudo que é necessário para provar ou sustentar a razão dessa frase, só pode agravar ainda mais a paz social que tanto necessitamos. Chega, chega não podemos continuar a viver nessa turbulência vida toda, meus irmãos guineenses, não é saudável, é tóxico, não é justo para um povo que tanto sofreu. data.description:

"ACHAS QUE AS NOSSAS MARCHAS SÃO RESULTADO DE VENDAS E COMPRAS?!" essa foi uma das frases da recente publicação que mostram por quem e para que fim, é dirigido o Guiné Puro ou melhor o blog do terror como podem ver já a seguir. TEMOS ALGUÉM NO AEROPORTO PARA NOS INFOMAR O DIA EM QUE EL CHEGAR. INVENTOU
AGRESSÃO E NESTE MOMENTO ESTÁ EM QUELUZ EM PORTUGAL. FILHO DA PUTA. MENTIROSO

COMPRAS?! VAMOS PROVAR DEPOIS. FIDJU DI BALETA Olá a todos, ainda bem que descobriram
que o Pirata informático- hackec é o Marcos Galina Barbosa, Eng. Informático.
Tentei várias vezes avisar o Ticha Aly Silva mas ele não respondeu e nem deu
importância julgo eu. No tempo da campanha para a liderança do Paigc, este
indivíduo era um fervoroso apoiante do Bá Quecuto no Facebook e a técnica que
usava era o envio de Phishing aos apoiantes do Dsp, recolhia informações
pessoais das pessoas que posteriormente eram expostas no Blog do Doka. Tentou
comigo mas não resultou. Tenham cuidado com este sujeito que está nas mãos de
B. Camara. Outra coisa, gostaria de conhecer a vossa página no Fecebook. Estamos Juntos. AC Nota GP: Até jovens inocentes,
Lesmes, Masta Tito e demais outros, os tais vendidos e comprados foram as tuas
vítimas. teu filho da puta que o bandido de Baciro Djá trouxe para Bissau para funções no aparelho de Estado e dizes que outros recebem favores.
Desde quando é que és mais honesto ou
mais competentes que os outros? Pagas e até pode ser com a tua vida para
perceberes as irresponsabilidades

data.title: DSP, UM PERIGO GRAVE PARA FUTURO DO PAÍS
data.description: Os meios de comunicação também são as formas de manipulação mais utilizadas pelos poderes políticos, dado o seu impacto social. As informações são manipuladas não apenas tendo em vista omitir factos relevantes, mas também distorcer o conteúdo da informação veiculada, produzir ou forjar a opinião pública, de modo que a mesma se ajuste às ideias dos gananciosos. A única forma dos cidadãos evitarem cair nestes processos de manipulação é tornarem-se mais vigilantes em relação às instituições democráticas e aos órgãos de informação, adoptando uma atitude de permanente reflexão crítica sobre a informação que lhes é fornecida. Na Guiné-Bissau, nos últimos anos, cresceu exponencialmente o número de pessoas mediocres, pessoas sem escrúpulos ligadas à produção de rádios e outros meios de comunicação com influencia na nossa sociedade, gente que apesar da sua enorme influência na sociedade, trabalha na mais completa impunidade e sem qualquer controlo ético/democrático. Obcecado pelo poder, ciente da dificuldade do povo guineense em avaliar informações, ciente do poder dos instrumentos de comunicação, Domingos Simões Pereira (DSP) nunca menosprezou esses instrumentos para atingir seu objectivo, sempre usou-os de forma desonesta como agora está a fazer tudo por tudo para manter no controlo desses veicúlos, mesmo que isso custe a vida dos outros. Governou na corrupção, no nepotismo e no desvios de somas astronómicas do dinheiro de povo, que muito serviria para investimentos na saúde, educação e outros serviços publicos, para beneficiar familiares e amigos. Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio. Documento António Aly Silva » aaly.silva@gmail.com » aaly_silva@hotmail.com » Tel. (+245) 668 31 13

Finge que preocupa com os problemas do país, mas só engana o povo honesto, humilde e trabalhador que infelizmente sofre muito, não sei até quando, devido a sua paciência e tolerância aos governantes como DSP, criminoso travestido em politico que vive na custa de povo e acima de tudo ainda fa-lo refem do próprio suor. Roubou e decepcionou tanto não só aos guineenses assim como a comunidade internacional que sempre acreditou que o sujeito era ideal para ajudar esse povo a sair do ciclo de sofrimento que parece infinito. Foi demitido, não conformou e está a fazer tudo na medida do possível para continuar a complicar a vida dos guineenses. Razão disso é que depois de perder a batalha nos meios de comunicações mais modernos nomeadamente os blogues onde investiu grandes somas do dinheiro de povo, para fazer a lavagem cerebral dos menos instruídos e não só. Fugiu do facebook onde sempre frequentava e comunicava com todos tentado passar a mensagem de um politico moderno e aberto a diálogo/opiniões, mas que afinal era simplesmente um falso modernista. Caiu a mascara e já não consegue enganar ninguem, pois a sua credibilidade está abaixo de zero, para não dizer outra coisa. Camaradas, para conhecimento geral, com o dinheiro roubado que custou suor de povo guineense, DSP decidiu avançar com um outro novo plano maquiavelico, para criar a sua própria estação de rádio.
